data.content_ref: inline:The 'Redundancy-Heterogeneity Trade-off' in SRC_005 integrates the claims of SRC_002 and SRC_003 by framing resilience as a match between the failure's causal nature (stochastic vs systemic) and the structural defense (redundancy vs heterogeneity); this relation is refuted if stochastic failures can be mitigated by heterogeneity or if systemic failures can be mitigated by homogeneous redundancy.
